column3: Process ID: ID used to reference this process throughout the DAK
column4: Personas: Individuals interacting to complete the process
column5: Objectives: A concrete statement describing what the process seeks to achieve
column6: Task set: The general set of activities performed within the process

column5: To ensure client is located in the system with updated personal details or, if not located, entered into the system to be put into a queue to await counselling
column6: Starting point: Client arrives at facility and checks in with clerk » Search for client record » Review and update client record » Create a new client record

column4: » Client » Health-care provider (clinician, nurse midwife or community health worker)
column5: To discuss possible family planning methods with client and for client to select a method that they are medically eligible for
column6: Starting point: Client has been registered at the health-care facility and called in for counselling. Family planning counselling can happen alongside other health services (e.g. nutrition counselling, child immunizations) » Take client history » Conduct a risk assessment » Discuss issues and concerns if a returning client or a client already on a method » Counsel on possible family planning methods and reproductive intentions » Check medical eligibility criteria » Select method » Check stock and skills for delivering method » If facility is not equipped to provide the method, refer

column5: To provide the method(s) or service(s) the client requires, if the client is medically eligible for them
column6: Starting point: Client has selected a method and is medically eligible or eligible with clinical judgement » Obtain informed consent » Determine when to start method » Provide method and/or explain how to use method » Discuss dual protection » Determine follow-up requirements and schedule follow-up, if needed

column5: To direct clients to services that are not available within this facility
column6: Starting point: Clinician determined client needs for services that are not available in this facility » Determine whether it is an emergency referral » Discuss referral locations » Contact destination facility » Provide information to destination facility » Discuss any questions with client

column5: To aggregate client-level data into validated, aggregate reports, use the data, and submit reports at the facility level
column6: Starting point: Time for periodic (usually monthly) reporting » Check data quality » Correct fixable errors » Generate and review aggregate reports » Submit for approval » Provide feedback and any changes required
